extractionHint.zh-CN: 已发现的线索、物证、矛盾证词，及其与齐老失踪、"钥匙"和裂潮真相的关联。
extractionHint.en-US: Discovered clues, evidence, and contradictions, and how they tie to Qi's disappearance, the "key", and the truth of the Riftide.

extractionHint.zh-CN: 已获得或见识过的远古遗物、其鉴定结果、效果、风险与归属。
extractionHint.en-US: Ancient relics obtained or seen, their appraisals, effects, risks, and ownership.

extractionHint.zh-CN: 关于退潮时间、深退潮预警、雾兽出没、雾蚀进展与安全/危险窗口的观察。
extractionHint.en-US: Observations on ebb timing, deep-withdrawal alerts, fog-beast sightings, fog-rot progression, and safe/danger windows.

extractionHint.zh-CN: 玩家对议会、公会、盐牙会、雾中教会作出的承诺，获得的许可、通缉、债务与人情，以及这些选择对各方态度的可见影响。
extractionHint.en-US: Promises made to the Council, Guild, Salt Fangs, and Congregation; permits, warrants, debts, favors, and the visible effect of those choices on each faction.
